commands:
set -eu
ROOT="$HOME/agent-workspace/repos/photomap/work"
WT="$HOME/agent-workspace/repos/photomap/worktrees/unified-ux-20261104-v1"
EXPECTED="09be8c4ef70a30791de2698c1c39779e4ab544eb"
test "$(git -C "$ROOT" branch --show-current)" = "agent-work"
test -z "$(git -C "$ROOT" status --porcelain)"
git -C "$WT" fetch origin main
test "$(git -C "$WT" rev-parse origin/main)" = "$EXPECTED"
git -C "$WT" checkout --detach origin/main
test -z "$(git -C "$WT" status --porcelain)"
test "$(git -C "$WT" rev-parse HEAD)" = "$EXPECTED"
cd "$WT/frontend"
VITE_API_BASE_URL= npm run build
test -s dist/index.html
echo "MAC_AGENT_WORK_SHA=$(git -C "$ROOT" rev-parse HEAD)"
echo "BUILD_SHA=$(git -C "$WT" rev-parse HEAD)"
echo "INDEX_SHA256=$(shasum -a 256 dist/index.html | awk '{print $1}')"
find dist/assets -maxdepth 1 -name 'public-map-*.js' -print
echo FRONTEND_BUILD_READY
set -eu
KEY="$HOME/.ssh/id_ed25519"
ssh -i "$KEY" -o BatchMode=yes -o StrictHostKeyChecking=yes -o ConnectTimeout=8 michal@192.168.0.23 'bash -s' <<'PI_SCRIPT'
set -eu
cd /home/michal/src/PhotoMaps
test "$(git branch --show-current)" = "main"
test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"
test "$(systemctl is-active photomap.service)" = active
test "$(systemctl is-active cloudflared.service)" = active
curl -fsS --max-time 8 http://127.0.0.1:8000/health >/dev/null
test -f backend/data/app.db
test -s frontend/dist/index.html
BACKUP=".dev/deploy/unified-ux-20261104-09be8c4"
test ! -e "$BACKUP"
mkdir -p "$BACKUP"
cp -a frontend/dist "$BACKUP/dist-before"
cp frontend/dist/index.html "$BACKUP/index-before.html"
git rev-parse HEAD > "$BACKUP/head-before.sha"
systemctl show photomap.service --property MainPID --value > "$BACKUP/backend-pid-before"
systemctl show cloudflared.service --property MainPID --value > "$BACKUP/tunnel-pid-before"
python3 - "$BACKUP/app-before.db" <<'PY'
import sqlite3
import sys
source = sqlite3.connect("file:backend/data/app.db?mode=ro", uri=True)
dest = sqlite3.connect(sys.argv[1])
source.backup(dest)
source.close()
result = dest.execute("PRAGMA quick_check").fetchone()[0]
dest.close()
if result != "ok":
    raise SystemExit("SQLite backup quick_check failed: " + result)
print("SQLITE_BACKUP_QUICK_CHECK=" + result)
PY
test -s "$BACKUP/dist-before/index.html"
test -s "$BACKUP/app-before.db"
echo "RELEASE_BACKUP=$BACKUP"
echo "PREVIOUS_PI_SHA=$(cat "$BACKUP/head-before.sha")"
echo "PREVIOUS_BACKEND_PID=$(cat "$BACKUP/backend-pid-before")"
echo "PREVIOUS_TUNNEL_PID=$(cat "$BACKUP/tunnel-pid-before")"
sha256sum "$BACKUP/index-before.html"
echo RELEASE_BACKUP_READY
PI_SCRIPT
